entry.title: Chocolate maker signs $6.6M sale-leaseback deal for warehouse site
entry.summary: The deal for Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory's Colorado facility, which also houses production operations and the company's headquarters, aims to cut existing debt.

entry.title: Texas sues Nestlé’s Gerber over alleged heavy metals in baby food
entry.summary: Gerber says it employs “careful ingredient sourcing, supplier requirements, testing and quality controls" to reduce heavy metal levels in its products.

entry.title: US semiconductor supply chain relies on vulnerable, hidden inputs
entry.summary: To guard against disruptions, the Semiconductor Industry Association called for closer government-industry collaboration to address targets for onshoring and stockpiling.

entry.title: Trump’s 50% Canada tariffs challenged in court
entry.summary: A lawsuit filed Tuesday with the Court of International Trade alleges the president exceeded his power in using a 96-year-old statute to impose tariffs.

entry.title: Napa Auto Parts revs up fulfillment efficiency with automation
entry.summary: Alongside Hy-Tek Intralogistics and Hai Robotics, the retailer aims to maximize warehouse storage density and improve order accuracy.

entry.title: Primo Brands opens first new factory post merger
entry.summary: The Arkansas plant will increase production for sparkling water brand Mountain Valley as demand for premium beverages surges.

entry.title: Extended peak season drives high dwell times at San Pedro Bay Ports
entry.summary: The Pacific Merchant Shipping Association said record volumes in September pushed up the time cargo remained idle, both for rail and truck transport.

entry.title: Apple expands US supplier network for iPhone materials, components
entry.summary: The company added a new titanium supplier and expanded its partnership with an advanced film maker as part of a $600 billion commitment to U.S. manufacturing.

entry.title: Stord expands network with AMS Fulfillment purchase
entry.summary: The acquisition bolsters Stord's presence in key East Coast and West Coast hubs while building upon other recent deals.

entry.title: Nestlé to close Ohio factory by end of 2027
entry.summary: The food giant will move production to South Carolina, saying it is "the most sustainable path forward" as consumer needs and volumes shift.
